reason: A bilingual and trilingual vocabulary-learning plugin centered on spaced repetition, quizzes, pronunciation, games, learner progress tracking, and optional AI tutoring.

summaries.zh: 一款通过间隔重复、测验、发音练习、游戏和可选 AI 辅导帮助用户学习英语词汇的多语言学习插件。
summaries.en: A multilingual vocabulary-learning plugin that combines spaced repetition, quizzes, pronunciation practice, games, progress tracking, and optional AI tutoring.

capabilities: Provides vocabulary learning, quizzes, games, pronunciation practice, and AI-assisted tutoring
Stores learner profiles, progress, review history, and study schedules in the browser
Optionally connects to DeepSeek or a Cloudflare Worker for AI explanations, stories, grading, and dictionary access
Supports Anki TSV export, AnkiConnect synchronization, and progress API synchronization
